metadata.name: Nigerian Exclusive Economic Zone (simplified)
metadata.notice: Simplified outline for operational display only. NOT a legal or navigational boundary. The landward edge follows the Nigerian coastline; the seaward edge is an approximate 200nm envelope and does not encode negotiated tri-point boundaries with Benin, Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea, or Sao Tome and Principe.
metadata.replaceWith: Official polygon from VLIZ Maritime Boundaries (marineregions.org, Nigeria EEZ) or the Nigerian Hydrographic Office.
